summary: Email from Sumanth Raman <contactsumanthraman@gmail.com> to immanuellourdu@gmail.com about: Madras Quiz Game Code
raw_ocr_excerpt:
Dear Participant,

Thank you for participating in the Madras Open Quiz 2020.

Please find below the link and game code to the prelims of the Madras Open
Quiz 2020 hosted on the Quizizz application.  Pls enter the game code at 12
pm to join the quiz.

Game Code: 927006

The following are the rules to be kept in mind for the prelims:

a. The prelims will consist of 40 questions. It will be entirely in
Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) format.
b. Each question will have to be answered within 45 seconds.
c. The scoring for each question will be based on the accuracy and the
speed at which it is answered. If the question is answered after 45
seconds, your points will drastically reduce.
d. Questions marked with asterisk (*) are starred questions for resolving
ties.
e. The link will be open for participation between 12 to 12.40 pm (For 40
minutes). The quiz will start at 12 noon.
f. Participants are required to enter the exact mobile number used for
registration as their login ID in the Quizizz application.
NO other number entered will be considered. There is NO need for the
country code to be entered. NO names are to be entered.
Remember, the number provided for registration (10 numbers for India or
less for participants abroad will suffice) is only to be entered.

Happy Quizzing!

For any queries, please mail us back on this E-Mail address -
madrasopenquiz1.madrasday@gmail.com / madrasopenquiz2020@snabquizzes.in.

Regards
Team Madras Quiz
